meta.title: Dimension-Based Routing: refused for a user without the Tenant Admin role
gaps: Navigate to Dimension-Based Routing and determine whether it is offered or usable for a user without the Tenant Admin role.
Repeat the same check as a Tenant Admin and compare the result on the same Enterprise tenant.
Verify or provision the tenant's Enterprise plan when no tenant ID is provided.
